name: Jitsi (SIP Communicator)
description: macOS is A (Sparkle DSA pinned); Windows hand-rolled Java updater has HTTPS but no payload verification before executing the installer.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Jitsi’s macOS update integration uses Sparkle, while Windows uses a separate update service. Framework enforcement and Windows artifact authentication require separate evidence; a single cross-platform trust classification is unsupported.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot, not the historical Jitsi release under study.
Sparkle framework verification and the Windows setup program's own controls were not audited; the result describes only the Jitsi-side integration and download method.

original_evidence.text: | Jitsi (SIP Communicator / Jitsi Desktop) | https://github.com/jitsi/jitsi | 7bde4ff / 2026-05-25 | Y (per-platform: Mac=Sparkle, Windows=custom Java updater) | Y (Mac: `SUScheduledCheckInterval`=86400s; Windows: interval/menu-triggered) | Y (Mac: Sparkle installs DMG; Windows: `FileUtils.download()` setup.exe then `new ProcessBuilder(command).start()`) | HTTPS both paths (`https://download.jitsi.org/...`); TLS enforced via Jitsi's own `CertificateVerificationService`/custom TrustManager (hostname check moved into the trust manager, not disabled) | **Mac = Y** (Sparkle appcast `sparkle:dsaSignature` enclosure attr); **Windows = N** (plain key=value `.properties` file, no signature field) | **Mac = DSA signature verified by Sparkle** against `SUPublicDSAKeyFile` bundled in app; **Windows = none** (no hash/sig check before executing downloaded setup.exe) | **Mac = pinned-in-binary** (`Contents/Resources/sparkle_dsa_pub.pem` shipped inside app bundle); **Windows = none/unpinned** | resources/install/mac/Info.plist (`SUPublicDSAKeyFile`, `SUFeedURL`), resources/install/src/mac/dist/Jitsi.app/Contents/Resources/sparkle_dsa_pub.pem, modules/plugin/update/src/main/java/.../UpdateServiceImpl.java:769-816 (download+`ProcessBuilder` exec, no verification), modules/service/httputil/src/main/java/.../HttpUtils.java:407-441 |
